skills.name: Greets customers and takes an order
skills.how: Model a greeting within a few seconds of a customer arriving. Have the trainee take orders while you stand beside them, then repeat each order back to the customer to confirm it.

skills.name: Rings up an order on the register
skills.how: Walk through the register screen once, then have the trainee ring up a few practice orders. Include one with a change, such as an extra shot or different milk.

skills.name: Handles cash, cards and refunds
skills.how: Show how to count change back out loud and how a card payment completes. Explain who approves refunds, then have the trainee do one with a supervisor watching.

skills.name: Hands off mobile and pickup orders
skills.how: Show where pickup orders print or appear and where finished orders go. Practice checking the name on the label before handing off.

skills.name: Pulls espresso shots
skills.how: Demonstrate a shot from start to finish, then have the trainee pull several. Check timing and appearance together, and explain when a shot should be remade.

skills.name: Steams milk
skills.how: Show the steaming steps and the target temperature. Have the trainee steam milk for a few drinks while you check the texture and temperature each time.

skills.name: Makes hot drinks
skills.how: Use the recipe guide for the most-ordered hot drinks. Have the trainee build each one while you watch, then taste and compare.

skills.name: Makes iced drinks
skills.how: Show the order to add ingredients and ice, and the cup size marks. Have the trainee make the most-ordered iced drinks with the recipe guide open.

skills.name: Makes blended drinks
skills.how: Show how to measure, which blender setting to use and how to clean the pitcher after. Have the trainee make two different blended drinks.

skills.name: Warms and serves food
skills.how: Show where food is stored, the warming setting for each item and how to bag or plate it. Have the trainee warm a few items on their own.

skills.name: Answers allergen questions
skills.how: Show where allergen information is kept. Practice looking up an item together, and explain when to get a supervisor instead of guessing.

skills.name: Mixes and checks sanitizer
skills.how: Show how to mix sanitizer and test it with a strip. Have the trainee mix a fresh bucket and test it while you watch.

skills.name: Cleans the espresso machine
skills.how: Walk through the cleaning steps at close. Have the trainee do them with the checklist in hand on their next closing shift.

skills.name: Completes the closing checklist
skills.how: Go through the closing checklist together on one shift. On the next, have the trainee lead it while you check each item.
